visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a short bob, wearing a navy checkered shirt and white skirt, stands before a futuristic silver structure. She smiles while holding a red-cased smartphone. (2) The scene abruptly zooms out digitally through a train window frame, revealing her as a small figure in front of the massive, curvaceous Dongdaemun Design Plaza in Seoul. (3) A quick cut shows her face in a joyful close-up, followed by a wide shot in a museum hall featuring large dinosaur skeletons and a giant sculpture of a sleeping dachshund in the foreground. (4) Various shots follow, including close-ups of K-pop celebrity billboards and the woman standing on a Seoul street corner under a black umbrella, gesturing excitedly toward the advertisements. (5) The final segment shows her at Incheon International Airport terminal, waving both hands with a bright expression as travelers walk by in the background of the brightly lit hall.

The music maintains a constant high energy with no breaks in the driving rhythm. There is no ambient noise or environmental sound present, indicating a purely post-produced audio track with high signal fidelity.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a satirical title about a non-existent iPhone 17 Pro to showcase a travel montage of iconic locations in Seoul. It uses fast-paced editing and zoom transitions to highlight the beauty and scale of the city while following a social media trend.
